tasks.title: How this board works
tasks.description:
A task on this board is a draft, which only the team sees, until its type is **Published**. Change its type to Published when the wording is right, and it shows on the Ideas page, where everybody can read it and vote for it, signed in or not. Change the type back to take it down. Its votes stay with it.

People see an idea's title, its description and its status, and how many voted. They never see its comments, assignees, properties or tags, so talk about it in the comments.

**Statuses.** People see each status by its name. Everybody who voted hears when an idea moves.

This task stays a draft: it is here for the team.
